payload.title: new test files miss the meta-gate registry
payload.body: Twice in one day (role-routing, what-ships) a unit added a test file and the whole gate went red on canon's META-GATE, which requires every test file to be classified in packages/canon/test/gate-convicts.test.ts. The planner's occurs law resolves where a concept is SPELLED, and the registry spells no concept, so it never enters outputs. Either the plan census should list the registry whenever a unit may add tests, or the meta-gate's registry should be derived rather than hand-kept.
